_comment: Task #72 fix: whole-GLB buildings at the fmg-1km WorldMap IR's burg anchors (assets/maps/fmg-1km.worldmap.json anchors: burg-highkeep civic [187.5,-62.5], burg-fisherton dwelling [62.5,312.5]), placed on the STREAMED map terrain (world.setTerrainSource kind:map, no editable terrain.create layer). village.build cannot be used here — it hard-requires an editable terrainEntity ('village.build: no terrain layer to build on') which the streamed path never creates. Fix: asset.place directly with an EXPLICIT y sampled offline from MapTerrainSource.sampleHeight at each anchor (Highkeep y=1.944225390752157, Fisherton y=2.0452205075158005), ground:true so the authored GLB's measured base sits exactly there. Both buildings are the SAME curated whole-GLB library assets village.build's KIND_TO_GLB uses (tools/design/build-world.mjs): civic->norman-manor-building.glb, dwelling->cottage-authored.glb. No archetype/kit/parametric path used anywhere.
